headlines.title: What are the national security implications of Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy?
headlines.description: President Trump defended Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang after the company's board announced it was investigating Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. NBC News' Kelly O'Donnell and Brian Cheung discuss the national security implications of Huang's affair considering his role in the global growth of AI and his vicinity to President Trump.

headlines.title: Trump defends Hegseth as he faces impeachment push
headlines.description: President Trump pushed back against calls to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, touting the administration's military operations in Venezuela and Iran. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Inflation likely took a breather last month as fuel prices fell
headlines.description: Americans are tired of inflation, as last week’s election results showed, but there was likely some relief last month as gas, diesel and jet fuel prices eased.

headlines.title: Russell Brand is sentenced to 10 years and six months for rape and sexual assault
headlines.description: Actor Russell Brand has been sentenced to 10 years and six months in a British prison for rape and sexual assault. Brand's victims told the court that they are still living with daily trauma because of what happened to them. NBC News' Danny Cevallos explains how Brand's sentence was determined.

headlines.title: Ohio State University investigating fraternity after video appears to show two people on fire
headlines.description: The Sigma Alpha Epsilon chapter is on suspension as the school and police investigate the incident.

headlines.title: Supreme Court paves way for Trump to build a section of his border wall in the Big Bend area of Texas
headlines.description: The Trump administration has faced opposition to its plan to build border security infrastructure in a remote part of Texas that includes Big Bend National Park.

headlines.title: Flu Season Kicks off Early: Is it Too Late to Get the Vaccine?
headlines.description: Flu activity is higher than usual for this time of year, according to the CDC, so NBC News medical contributor, Dr. Akshay Syal, joins TODAY with tips to stay healthy. He discusses why there’s an early uptick in numbers, how to protect against the strain that is circulating, and how to manage your symptoms if you do get the flu.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: A Haitian 8-year-old was taken by ICE at routine check-in, rattling a San Diego school district
headlines.description: The school district and immigration advocates said the boy was separated from his cousins and uncle, who was taking care of him after his father was deported last year.

headlines.title: Trump defends Pete Hegseth at surprise news briefing with Dana White
headlines.description: In his first post-midterm news briefing, President Donald Trump on Monday talked about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy, the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and the massive Republican losses at the ballot box last week.

headlines.title: Trump Media cashes in on high-speed access to social media posts
headlines.description: Trump Media and Technology Group reported that revenue surged 205%, which it says was “primarily driven” by selling a high-speed feed of posts on Truth Social.
